cv.name: Tegan Lockwood
cv.headline: Executive Assistant | CEO Support | Public sector, arts and health
cv.summary: Executive assistant with seven years of admin and office leadership across mining, allied health, the arts and a water utility. Moves easily between sectors and takes on whatever keeps the office running.

experience.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
bullets: Manage the CEO's diary, correspondence and stakeholder meetings with councils and state agencies
Coordinate board and committee papers, minutes and action registers
Introduced a briefing note template now used across the executive team
Arrange domestic travel and regional site visits

experience.title: Personal Assistant (12-month contract)
bullets: Supported the Artistic Director and General Manager through the festival season
Booked travel and accommodation for 120 visiting artists

experience.title: Practice Manager
bullets: Ran three clinics' front desk, rosters and Medicare and WorkCover billing in Cliniko
Reduced unpaid invoices over 60 days by half

experience.title: Site Administration Officer (FIFO)
bullets: Timesheets, inductions and camp bookings for a crew of 90
